SP-2026.09.1-faultmask.notes: Targeted build off stable SP-2026.08.1. Ignores module fault bits the reporting board's firmware cannot set, which stops a phantom AC Switch 'General overcurrent' alarm and the log flooding it caused. GUI change only - no firmware components, so no board is reprogrammed by this package.

SP-2026.09.2-faultmask.notes: Targeted build off stable SP-2026.08.1. Ignores module fault bits the reporting board's firmware cannot set, which stops a phantom AC Switch 'General overcurrent' alarm and the log flooding it caused. Adds a bounded grace period so no false alarm slips through at start-up before board identification arrives. GUI change only - no firmware components, so no board is reprogrammed by this package.
